'''Nibbit''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Nibbit}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Butt
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc2|9|13}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hesitant Slice
|Intent = Attack2, Defend
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage. Gains (5;{{Asc2|8|6}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hiss
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}

Intent cycles in order. After {{Int2|Nibbit|Hiss}} their intent wraps back around to {{Int2|Nibbit|Butt}}, followed by {{Int2|Nibbit|Hesitant Slice}} and then {{Int2|Nibbit|Hiss}} again. Starting intent is encounter dependent.

==== Solo Encounter ====

When alone (Nibbits Weak encounter), the Nibbit opens with {{Int2|Nibbit|Butt}}. It's good strategy to aim to win on one of the {{Int2|Nibbit|Butt}} repeats, so either turn 4 or 7. Nibbit buffs the turn prior, giving you 2 full turns to spend energy on nothing but attacks and finish the combat before the big attack lands.

==== Paired Encounter ====

When paired (Nibbits Normal encounter), the front Nibbit opens with {{Int2|Nibbit|Hesitant Slice}} and the back Nibbit opens with {{Int2|Nibbit|Hiss}}.
